title: Sectionwise inverse image preserves flat module sheaves
statement: Let $g:X\to Y$ be a scheme isomorphism with essentially small pro-etale sites, $R_Y,R_X$ commutative ring sheaves, $c:g^{-1}R_Y\cong R_X$, and $F$ the additive sectionwise inverse-image module functor identified with the displayed construction. Then $F$ sends every flat $R_Y$-module sheaf to a flat $R_X$-module sheaf.

source.place: Step 1, tensor preservation argument of lem-pod-sectionwise-flat-kflat; the indicated clause

proof.text: Use the local finite-relation criterion for flatness. For an object U of X.ProEt and a finite relation in the transported module, send its coefficients through c inverse. The underlying module sections are those of M at G(U), so this is a relation in M. Apply the forward local equational criterion to obtain a covering sieve S and finite factorization matrices.

The site functor G is cocontinuous: assemble its stated equivalence with inverse postcomposition, and use the cover-preserving inverse and Mathlib Adjunction.isCocontinuous_iff_coverPreserving. Thus the functor pullback of S covers U.

On every arrow of that pulled-back sieve, send the factorization coefficients forward through c and keep the module sections. The identities c inverse composed with c equals identity prove the factorization equations with the transported action. Apply c to the original zero coefficient sums; additivity, multiplicativity, naturality of c, and c composed with c inverse equals identity prove the new coefficient sums vanish. The converse local criterion gives flatness. The argument includes empty relations and zero coefficient rings.

proof_origin.place: lemma-flat-eq (Tag 08FC), applied to the sectionwise special case of lemma-pullback-flat (Tag 05VD)

theorem isoSectionwiseModuleInverseImage_preservesFlat
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} X.ProEt] [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} Y.ProEt]
    (RY : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (RX : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (c : (isoSectionwiseInverseImage g CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj RY ≅ RX)
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u + 1} ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology Y)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj RY) ⥤
      SheafOfModules.{u + 1} ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj RX)) [F.Additive]
    (_hF : F = isoSectionwiseModuleInverseImage.{u, u} g
      (RY := (sheafCompose (ProEt.topology Y)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj RY)
      (RX := (sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj RX)
      ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).mapIso c).hom) :
    ∀ M : SheafOfModules.{u + 1} ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology Y)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj RY),
      SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite.{u + 1, u, u + 1, u + 1}
        (J := ProEt.topology Y) (R := RY) M →
        SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite.{u + 1, u, u + 1, u + 1}
          (J := ProEt.topology X) (R := RX) (F.obj M)
